findings.issue: Goal bone_joint_health not aligned with questionnaire goal joint_comfort; may never trigger. Joint symptoms alone cannot diagnose osteoarthritis.
findings.fix: Map to canonical goal, screen red flags, distinguish curcumin formulation and liver injury risk.

findings.issue: Known liver disease blocked but rare supplement-associated liver injury may occur without known prior liver disease.
findings.fix: Ingredient-specific liver injury warning, symptoms and formulation review.

findings.issue: Positive score without checking renal unknown status, age and actual training context within same rule.
findings.fix: Mandatory global safety gate before score can produce recommendation.

findings.issue: Session duration stored as string buckets including >90; source-specific clinical justification for commercial electrolyte mix not demonstrated.
findings.fix: Normalize duration, sweat context, heat, sodium losses and exact product composition; check medications.

findings.issue: Heart/kidney condition gate not sufficient for potassium-containing blends and ACE inhibitors, ARBs or potassium-sparing diuretics.
findings.fix: Add ingredient-specific medication screening and potassium total.

findings.issue: Low iodized salt and animal foods are proxy indicators, not confirmation of deficiency.
findings.fix: Evaluate pregnancy, thyroid disease, seaweed, fortified foods and excess iodine.

findings.issue: Awards positive iron score from nonspecific fatigue even without deficiency evidence.
findings.fix: Remove positive score; refer for evaluation and appropriate labs.

findings.issue: Positive iron score and professional-review override coexist; implementation must ensure override dominates ranking.
findings.fix: Assert safety override precedence in tests.

findings.issue: Vegetarian diet is risk context, not diagnosis of iron deficiency.
Dietary gaps goal alone awards magnesium score; not an ingredient-specific deficiency.
findings.fix: Require intake assessment and consider elemental dose and renal status.

findings.issue: Low sunlight is risk context not definitive vitamin D deficiency.
findings.fix: Do not imply diagnosis or blanket supplementation dose.
